background_story: Azariah was a bright and ambitious college student, known for his sharp mind and quick wit. However, his life took a dramatic turn when he suffered a seizure during a particularly grueling exam. The episode left him shaken and uncertain about his future. As he underwent medical tests and evaluations, Azariah learned that he had a rare neurological condition that made him prone to seizures. Despite the challenges, he refused to let his condition define him. With the support of his loved ones and a newfound appreciation for life, Azariah adapted to his new reality. He learned to manage his condition, finding innovative ways to cope with the seizures and continue pursuing his dreams. Azariah's resilience and determination inspired those around him, proving that even in the face of adversity, the human spirit can persevere.
